description: This file contains formatting functions for provider usage data, including summaries and detailed reports, utilizing imported utility functions and types related to provider usage.

methods.name: formatResetRemaining
methods.description: Formats the remaining time until a reset based on target milliseconds and current time.

methods.name: formatWindowShort
methods.description: Formats a short summary of a usage window, including remaining percentage and reset info.

methods.name: formatUsageWindowSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary string for provider usage windows, optionally including reset times.

methods.name: formatUsageSummaryLine
methods.description: Creates a concise line summarizing provider usage, highlighting the provider with the highest usage.

methods.name: formatUsageReportLines
methods.description: Produces detailed report lines for all provider usage entries, including errors and no-data cases.
